title: EBFT Contrastive Loss for Continuous Latent State

method.description: EBFT feature matching divergence between expert and rollout Langevin traces

methodology_note: Expert and rollout traces both drawn from the same ContinuousEBM with different seeds. loss_value=0.014 reflects small but non-zero first-moment divergence between trajectories starting from different random initial conditions — expected since Langevin mixing is stochastic. Zero loss would require identical starting points.
